_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Mo ye zo {player_id} na Tic Tac Toe ti zo wale moko.
Mo ti zo '{symbol}'.
Mo ye ti na koli zo ti 5 koli 5 ti zo ligne ti 4.
Ligne ti ye ti koli na ndo, koli na pama, ndo ti pama.
Mo fa ti zo na format '[4]' ti zo ti koli 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A yeke na lege ni pëpe ti zia mbeni ye nde. Zia "[cell]" tongana a tene 0-{max_cell} so ayeke yâ ti da.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Kɛt cɛl kuɔɔt: {cell}. Kɛkɛ̈ ye guɔ̈p 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.already_occupied: A zia mbeni tënë na yâ ti cellule {cell} awe.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Zo ti pikango ndembo {player_id} asala mbeni ye so ayeke na lege ni pëpe.

outcome.draw: A sara match ni na lege ti kpongo zo oko pëpe!
